the <appDataDir>/model-catalogue.json path, bundled/operator/harness-offered
precedence, invalid-file fallback, and removal of the legacy model key; include
a worked example with two updatedAt values that demonstrates which catalogue
wins.

In `@packages/frontend/src/components/agent/RunToolbar.tsx`:
- Around line 109-133: Update the `RunToolbar` model popover so that when
`ignored` is true it hides both the suggestions list and the `model-note` block,
and replaces the input form with a single “Clear” action that calls
`choose(undefined)`. Preserve the existing suggestions and form behavior when
`ignored` is false.

📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This change adds model catalogues and harness-offered model suggestions, stores model settings per harness, and refuses unsupported model selections. It also detects unknown ACP values, records them in investigation transcripts, and forwards warnings. ### Changes **Harness Model Selection** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Catalogue and unsupported-model rules**
`packages/@prismalens/config/src/providers/model-catalogue.*`, `packages/@prismalens/config/src/providers/harness.*`, `packages/@prismalens/config/src/harness.ts`, `packages/@prismalens/config/tsconfig.json`|Adds a versioned bundled catalogue, catalogue parsing and selection by `updatedAt`, model lookup, and `refuseModel` for models set on unsupported harnesses.| |**Offered-model discovery and status**
`packages/@prismalens/engine/src/runner/acp-client.*`, `packages/@prismalens/engine/src/run/harness-doctor.ts`, `packages/api/src/core/harness/harness-models.service.*`, `packages/api/src/core/harness/harness-probe.service.ts`, `packages/api/src/core/harness/harness.module.ts`, `packages/@prismalens/contracts/src/schemas/settings.ts`, `packages/api/openapi.json`|ACP sessions extract offered models from `session/new`. Probes and the API retain these models, and harness status returns model suggestions from the harness or catalogue.| |**Per-harness settings and run selection**
`packages/@prismalens/contracts/src/schemas/settings.ts`, `packages/api/openapi.json`, `packages/api/src/core/harness/harness.service.*`, `packages/api/src/infrastructure/dispatch/dispatch.service.*`|Settings use a per-harness model map, with `null` clearing an entry. Run selection checks the model for the selected harness and returns `model-unsupported` when that harness cannot take it. Dispatch reads the selected harness’s model setting.| |**Model selection controls**
`packages/frontend/src/components/agent/AgentPicker.tsx`, `packages/frontend/src/components/agent/RunToolbar.tsx`, `packages/frontend/src/lib/api/hooks/use-settings-orpc.ts`|The frontend reads and updates models per harness. The picker shows suggestions and status labels, permits clearing a stored unsupported model, and refreshes harness status after a successful check.| **ACP Drift Reporting** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**ACP unknown-value detection**
`packages/@prismalens/engine/src/runner/acp-client.*`, `packages/@prismalens/engine/src/run/__fixtures__/fake-acp-harness.mjs`, `packages/@prismalens/engine/src/run/investigate.test.ts`|The ACP client detects unknown session updates, tool kinds and statuses, and stop reasons. It reports each unknown value once per session; tests verify that detection does not fail the turn.| |**Transcript and host warning propagation**
`packages/@prismalens/engine/src/run/investigate.ts`, `packages/api/src/infrastructure/dispatch/investigation-run.ts`, `packages/@prismalens/engine/src/run/investigate.test.ts`|Investigation runs write detected drift to the transcript and pass warning messages to the host, where the API logs them.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Harness participant AcpSession participant probeHarness participant HarnessProbeService participant HarnessModelsService participant HarnessService participant Frontend Harness->>AcpSession: Return model options in session/new AcpSession-->>probeHarness: Expose parsed models probeHarness-->>HarnessProbeService: Return probe result with models HarnessProbeService->>HarnessModelsService: Remember offered models HarnessService->>HarnessModelsService: Request model suggestions HarnessService-->>Frontend: Return harness status with models ``` ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant AcpSession participant runInvestigation participant Transcript participant DispatchLogger AcpSession->>runInvestigation: Report unknown protocol value runInvestigation->>Transcript: Write drift as inbound wire line runInvestigation->>DispatchLogger: Send formatted drift warning ```
**Merge Risk:** _🔵 Low_ · up to `69e43` Model suggestions and per-harness model settings work as intended. Two small gaps remain. The model picker for a harness that cannot take a model can re-save a model that keeps runs blocked, when it should only offer to clear it. The new catalogue drop-in and the per-harness `models` setting are also undocumented. Both are small follow-ups and do not block the core behavior.
